_readme: Character cards. Write @name in a prompt; the expander replaces it with the full visual description (hair, eyes, clothes, props, face) and adds left/right positions when several cards are used. Add your own cards below. Descriptions are plain visual words, so the model draws a look-alike, not an exact copy.

kaito.look: a tall young man with spiky white hair and a black blindfold covering his eyes, dark high-collared uniform, relaxed confident smile
kaito.body: loose, casual posture, one hand in his pocket

ryu.look: a muscular man with pink-red spiky hair, sharp black tattoo lines on his face and arms, open dark robe, fierce red eyes

mina.look: a teenage girl with long black hair tied in a ponytail, large brown eyes, white school blouse and red scarf

dragonling.look: a small green dragon with four legs, short wings, round yellow eyes and a spiked tail
